columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Tool graphs need execution-proven edges, not schema compatibility alone
columns.title_zh: 工具图的组合边需要真实执行证据，而不能只靠 Schema 兼容
columns.source_zh: KOPA-Bench / EDGE 一手研究：145 个真实多步公共 API 任务，并以实际 API 成功调用筛选可执行 Tool-composition Edge
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260909-006 after Skill 02 triage. KOPA-Bench and EDGE distinguish a structurally compatible tool connection from one that has actually executed successfully against a live system: candidate output-to-input links are retained only after real public-API calls succeed, and trajectories are then synthesized over that execution-validated graph. The bounded Digital Employee governance question is what evidence must exist before a runtime may treat a tool-to-tool transition as an executable capability rather than a schema-level possibility. This is a primary benchmark/research finding with a concrete failure mode, executable mechanism and measured downstream model gains. It is materially distinct from the September 8 GUI/CLI provenance object, which concerned one application state across two control surfaces; today's question concerns admission of composition edges in a tool graph before a digital worker relies on them operationally.
columns.reason_zh: 经 Skill 02 筛选后选自 SIG-20260909-006。KOPA-Bench 与 EDGE 明确区分“结构上兼容的工具连接”和“已经在真实系统中成功执行的工具连接”：Output-to-input 候选边只有在公共 API 实际调用成功后才被保留，随后才在这张 Execution-validated Graph 上生成 Trajectory。因此，边界清晰的数字员工治理问题是：Runtime 在把 Tool-to-tool Transition 当作可执行能力、允许数字员工真正依赖它之前，必须具备什么样的执行证据。该对象是一手 Benchmark/Research Finding，具有明确 Failure Mode、可执行 Mechanism 与量化的下游模型收益。它与 9 月 8 日 GUI/CLI Provenance 对象实质不同：后者研究两个 Control Surface 如何共同作用于同一 Application State，今天研究的是 Tool Graph 中 Composition Edge 在被业务依赖前如何完成准入。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the 145-task benchmark construction, public-API set, candidate edge generation, exact live-execution validation rule, failure filtering, trajectory synthesis, 9B/27B comparison, BFCL transfer result, reproducibility limits, API instability, and what a successful benchmark call does not prove about future authorization, identity or side effects in production.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 145 个任务的 Benchmark 构造、公共 API 集合、Candidate Edge 生成、真实执行准入规则、失败过滤、Trajectory Synthesis、9B/27B 比较、BFCL Transfer 结果、可复现性边界、API 不稳定性，以及一次 Benchmark 调用成功不能证明哪些生产环境中的未来 Authorization、Identity 与 Side Effect 结论。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Scientific-agent evaluation must separate execution competence from evidentiary judgment
columns.title_zh: 科学 Agent 评估必须把执行能力与证据判断能力分开
columns.source_zh: TruthInsightBench 一手研究：40 项同行评审研究构造的 Blind Discovery Task，并对四种 Coding Agent 的 Artifact-grounded 科学判断进行评估
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260909-005 after Skill 02 triage. TruthInsightBench hides source conclusions, expected values and analysis paths across 40 blind discovery tasks derived from 40 peer-reviewed studies, then evaluates four coding agents on one frozen base model. The reported 58.4–60.3/100 plateau shows comparatively competent execution and documentation but weaker controls, robustness, falsifiability and cross-dataset generalization. The bounded Industry Architecture question is therefore which independent evidence dimensions an organization must evaluate before treating an agent that can execute research workflows as a trustworthy knowledge worker. This is a strong primary benchmark finding with explicit counterevidence to equating task completion with evidentiary judgment. It is distinct from the September 7 independent software-acceptance object: that object separated implementer and tester roles in long-horizon development, while this object tests whether the agent's own scientific claims are warranted by evidence even when execution succeeds.
columns.reason_zh: 经 Skill 02 筛选后选自 SIG-20260909-005。TruthInsightBench 从 40 项同行评审研究构造 40 个 Blind Discovery Task，隐藏原论文结论、期望值和 Analysis Path，再在同一个 Frozen Base Model 上评估四种 Coding Agent。论文报告的 58.4–60.3/100 窄平台表明：执行和文档能力相对成熟，但 Controls、Robustness、Falsifiability 与 Cross-dataset Generalization 明显较弱。因此，边界清晰的行业架构问题是：一个 Agent 即使能够完成研究 Workflow，组织在把它视为可信 Knowledge Worker 之前，还必须独立评估哪些 Evidence Dimension。该对象以一手 Benchmark Finding 直接反驳“Task Completion 等于 Evidentiary Judgment”。它与 9 月 7 日 Independent Software Acceptance 对象实质不同：后者研究长期开发中执行者与独立测试者的角色分离，今天研究的是即使执行成功，Agent 自己提出的科学 Claim 是否真正受到证据支持。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the 40-study/40-task construction, ten-domain coverage, blinding procedure, four-agent frozen-model setup, artifact-grounded scoring dimensions, 58.4–60.3 score plateau, controls/robustness/falsifiability/generalization results, pairwise significance, deterministic aggregation, leakage controls, and limits on generalizing scientific-discovery findings to other enterprise knowledge work.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 40 Study/40 Task 构造、10 个 Domain、Blinding Procedure、四 Agent Frozen-model 设置、Artifact-grounded Scoring Dimension、58.4–60.3 分数平台、Controls/Robustness/Falsifiability/Generalization 结果、Pairwise Significance、Deterministic Aggregation、Leakage Control，以及将科学发现 Agent 结论推广到其他企业知识工作时的边界。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.reason: No Selection. SIG-20260909-002 exposes a high-value TOCTOU/path-authorization mechanism: authorization of a pathname can be invalidated by a symlink swap before host access, and descriptor-relative no-follow traversal binds execution more tightly to the authorized object. But today's evidence is one maintainer implementation from OpenAI Agents SDK and does not yet satisfy Skill 02's preferred independent/comparative evidence gate. SIG-20260909-003 is concrete implementation evidence for replaying completed workflow children only when durable output/state proves completion, but its underlying duplicate-effect/recovery-evidence question substantially overlaps the September 1 durable recovery transcript object and the September 4 interrupted-tool replay-safety object. Elevating it today would repeat an existing recovery/effect-evidence research problem rather than add a material new delta.
columns.reason_zh: No Selection。SIG-20260909-002 提供了高价值的 TOCTOU/Path Authorization 机制：Pathname 在授权后、Host Access 前可能被 Symlink Swap 改写；基于 Directory Descriptor 的 No-follow Traversal 能把执行更紧地绑定到已授权对象。但今天的证据只有 OpenAI Agents SDK 的一个 Maintainer Implementation，尚未满足 Skill 02 偏好的独立/比较证据门槛。SIG-20260909-003 则具体展示了：Workflow Retry 时，只有留下 Durable Output/State 的已完成 Child 才能凭完成证据被 Replay；但它的底层 Duplicate-effect/Recovery-evidence 问题与 9 月 1 日 Durable Recovery Transcript、9 月 4 日 Interrupted-tool Replay Safety 已高度重叠。今天再次提升会重复既有 Recovery/Effect-evidence 研究问题，而不是形成实质新 Research Delta。
columns.next: Retain SIG-20260909-002 as a candidate for a future cross-implementation comparison of path-object authorization, TOCTOU and sandbox roots. Treat SIG-20260909-003 as duplicate evidence for the existing durable-recovery/replay-safety research line rather than a new Daily object. Reading must perform no Open-source Engineering Deep Reading for this run.
columns.next_zh: 保留 SIG-20260909-002 为 Candidate，等待围绕 Path-object Authorization、TOCTOU 与 Sandbox Root 的跨实现比较证据；将 SIG-20260909-003 作为既有 Durable-recovery/Replay-safety 研究线的重复证据，而不是新的 Daily Object。本轮 Reading 不得为开源工程栏目执行 Deep Reading。
